name: The Fallen Aces
description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:worker)(Character)Your own gang of Goons and Mooks, all roughly middle-aged Italian men with varying proficiencies in barehanded fighting, pipes, and ranged weapons. They are not very smart but very loyal. You start with 100 Goons/Mooks and gain more as you grow stronger. Reference: https://fallenaces.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Enemies#Gangster_enemies-0
